past.title: General Body Meeting — Spring Wrap-Up
past.summary: Reviewed the spring semester, recognized graduating seniors, and opened officer applications for the 2026–27 academic year.
notes: 16 members attended; 4 graduating seniors recognized with chapter pins.
Officer applications open through 4/30 — Treasurer and Outreach Chair both have open seats.
Voted to allocate remaining budget toward fall plant tour transportation.
Reminder: complete the national NAYGN membership renewal over the summer.

past.title: Industry Talk: Women in Nuclear Panel
past.summary: Panel discussion with three UF alumnae now working at Duke Energy, the NRC, and Westinghouse.
notes: Panelists shared career paths from undergrad to current roles.
Discussed internship timelines — most utilities recruit 9–12 months ahead of start date.
Q&A covered relocation, security clearances, and work-life balance.
Resumes collected and forwarded to panelists for referral consideration.

past.title: Outreach: Energy Fair at Sunshine STEM Festival
past.summary: Chapter ran a booth on nuclear fission with a tabletop reactor model for the community STEM festival.
notes: Estimated 200+ kids and families visited the NAYGN booth.
Cloud chamber demo was the most popular activity again.
Thanks to the 8 volunteers who worked shifts — outreach hours logged for national NAYGN credit.
Consider ordering a second cloud chamber kit for next year — line was long.

past.title: General Body Meeting — Spring Kickoff
past.summary: First meeting of the spring semester — set the event calendar and reviewed fall budget.
notes: Reviewed fall semester budget — under by $120, carries over to spring.
Finalized spring event calendar (see Agenda page).
New member sign-ups: 11 students added to the GroupMe.
Discussed potential joint event with UF Society of Women Engineers.
